finding.before: When the execution turn supplied a caller idempotencyKey, the journal intent lived under operation_key = sha256({tenantId, callerIdempotencyKey}) but the approval did not persist that key. The TTL sweep recomputed the derived key, found no journal record, inferred no_effect, and released to APPROVED; a retry with a changed/absent key could re-execute the tool after a crash, producing a duplicate effect.
finding.after: ApprovalReserveInput/ApprovalRecord/ApprovalReservation carry an optional validated operationKey; ApprovalEngine.reserve persists the effective key on the reservation and exposes it; the governed runtime computes the key before reserve, passes it and reuses the persisted key for journal reserve/markEffectStarted/confirm and the outbox idempotencyKey. The TTL sweep consults the PERSISTED key: absent under a persisted key with a never-EXECUTING approval is no_effect; EFFECT_STARTED/UNCERTAIN/CONFIRMED, unverifiable binding, lookup failure or legacy approvals without a persisted key produce unknown and the engine keeps UNCERTAIN, never APPROVED.

contract: docs/02_spec/aaa_execution_contract.md section 4 (orphan reservation recovery: release to APPROVED only with proof of absence; doubt => UNCERTAIN)
docs/02_spec/aaa_execution_contract.md section 7 (durable intent and effect journal)

guarantees: A duplicate effect after crash + TTL with a caller idempotency key is now impossible through the governed runtime: the persisted key is authoritative for the journal, the sweep and the outbox.

Absent journal evidence is proof of no effect only under a persisted key with a never-EXECUTING approval; RESERVED/ABANDONED/EFFECT_FAILED records are proof; everything ambiguous (EFFECT_STARTED/UNCERTAIN/CONFIRMED, binding mismatch, lookup failure, legacy keyless absence) resolves to UNCERTAIN and never releases.
releaseExpired honors unknown as no release and transitions to UNCERTAIN; no test asserts a release under ambiguous evidence.
The operation key is persisted on reserve, exposed on the record/reservation, stable across CAS transitions and generations, and a divergent key is rejected without mutation.
The same resolved operation key feeds journal reserve/markEffectStarted/confirmEffect and the outbox idempotencyKey (R-ID-1/R-ID-5).
Sweep and recovery never execute an effect: the new suites assert toolExecutor and outbox are never called.
